# Boiler Service

The combi boiler is serviced every October.

- The pressure gauge should read about 1.5 bar when cold.
- Bleed every radiator with the key before the first cold week.
- Radiator bleeding drops the pressure, so top up via the filling loop afterwards.

Engineer's last visit: 2026-10-14, flue gas readings normal.
